name: @candy/coding-agent
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../tui run build && npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig ./src/bun/cli.ts ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile dist/candy && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/presentation/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/presentation/export-html/template.html src/presentation/export-html/template.css src/presentation/export-html/template.js dist/presentation/export-html/ && shx cp src/presentation/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/presentation/export-html/vendor/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/presentation/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/presentation/export-html/template.html src/presentation/export-html/template.css src/presentation/export-html/template.js dist/presentation/export-html/ && shx cp src/presentation/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/presentation/export-html/vendor/ && shx cp -r docs dist/ && shx cp -r examples dist/ && shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run shrinkwrap

author: Mario Zechner
